description.en: Fully symmetric PI rules from the literature, reproduced for comparison: F. D. Witherden, P. E. Vincent: On the identification of symmetric quadrature rules for finite element methods. Comput. Math. Appl. 69 (2015). Nodes and weights as published (15 digits); the build re-checks the moment equations.
description.de: Voll symmetrische PI-Regeln aus der Literatur, zum Vergleich übernommen: F. D. Witherden, P. E. Vincent: On the identification of symmetric quadrature rules for finite element methods. Comput. Math. Appl. 69 (2015). Knoten und Gewichte wie veröffentlicht (15 Stellen); der Build rechnet die Momentengleichungen nach.
